rationale: The message reports concrete observed TOML emitter behavior and formatting details, not a question or request. It delivers test results about scalar, nested object, null, array, and empty table serialization.

evidence.text: TOML emitter: top scalars each `k = val`; nested object preceded blank line `[o]`; -i adds two leading spaces to nested scalar lines.
Null-only object emits empty. Arrays inline `[1, "x"]`. Empty nested table still emits `[empty]\n`.
TOML emitter: top scalars each `k = val`; nested object preceded blank line `[o]`
